$comment: Shipped limit defaults. Precedence: these defaults < settings.json < target facts < project facts < a one-shot override approved by the user. max is a hard ceiling that no setting or override can exceed. cost_model says how the cost grows with the value.

trace.callgraph_depth.description: Static call-graph depth when choosing the methods a trace patches.

survey.scope.cost_model: all includes engine and framework assemblies (several times larger)
survey.scope.description: Assemblies surveyed and indexed: game = non-engine assemblies.

content.scan.types.cost_model: linear in loaded objects of the included types
content.scan.types.description: Types included in content scans: a preset or a list of type names.

response.max_tokens.description: Size of a single tool result; larger parts become redaction stubs backed by a file.

view.depth.description: Default value-encoding depth for live reads.

view.max_items.description: Default items encoded per collection for live reads.

research.max_sources.description: Online research: sources per research run.

research.max_tokens.description: Online research: size of the recorded results.

research.max_age_days.cost_model: older results are reused instead of researched again
research.max_age_days.description: Online research: age after which results count as stale.

task.wait_poll_s.cost_model: longer waits risk the client's request timeout
task.wait_poll_s.description: Longest a single task_wait call blocks (kept below common client timeouts).

runtime.connect_timeout_s.cost_model: time spent waiting for the agent
runtime.connect_timeout_s.description: Wait for the agent after launching the game.

digest.max_tokens.description: Size of the KNOWLEDGE.md and NOTES.md digests.

task.max_duration.cost_model: wall time of a background task
task.max_duration.description: Background task wall time before it pauses and asks.
